raw_response:
This plot is for beans mixed with other crops, and for a field like this I usually do not buy chemical fertilizer because it is costly and beans can still grow without it. I will use my own local seed and put some manure if I can gather enough, because that is cheaper for me. I depend on the rains, not irrigation, and I will mostly use family labor, with only a few hired days if we are pressed at planting or weeding time.
